svg.title: Gradient descent on an elliptic quadratic
svg.desc: Contour ellipses of f(x1,x2)=x1 squared plus twice x2 squared, with gradient descent iterates starting at (2.5,2) and approaching the unique minimum (0,0).
svg.text: Gradient descent on an elliptic quadratic
Gradient steps reduce the objective; the minimum is at the origin.
